about: P3 lab exports (ARCHITECTURE-P3C D3, §9.5, §10.1 accept.p3c.p3-exports), recorded from the unchanged engine at commit cad4ac9 before any P3c code: the topology document (schema 1.3, profile P3) every CCNA 3 lab of cad4ac9 exports right after the worker loads it (lab seed, lab stamp, scheduled faults). The labs are the keys of this file, frozen by lab id. Change it only as P3C §9.5 allows, entry by entry, by re-recording with NF_RECORD_P3_EXPORTS.

objectives: Make R1 the designated router and R2 its backup
Keep R3 out of the election
Run the R3–R4 link as point-to-point
Reach PC4 from PC1
ccna3-ospf-dr-election.notes: On a shared segment every router becomes fully adjacent only to the designated router and its backup; the others stay in two-way state with each other. The election runs once and is never repeated just because a better router arrives.

objectives: Bring R1 into OSPF with network statements
Bring R3 into OSPF with interface lines
Fix both router IDs
Keep hellos off the host LANs

Declare the speed of the carrier circuit
Make both paths cost the same

Advertise R1's default route into OSPF

ccna3-eigrp-feasible-successor.notes: EIGRP keeps a backup path only when the neighbour offering it is provably closer to the destination than the best path is: its reported distance must be lower than the feasible distance.

# inventory.py - read the interfaces of every switch through its RESTCONF API
import requests

SWITCHES = ["10.0.99.11", "10.0.99.12", "10.0.99.13"]
AUTH = ("admin", "Api-Lab40")

total = 0
for address in SWITCHES:
    url = "https://" + address + "/restconf/data/ietf-interfaces:interfaces"
    r = requests.get(url, auth=AUTH)
    r.raise_for_status()
    interfaces = r.json()["ietf-interfaces:interfaces"]["interface"]
    total += len(interfaces)
    print(address, "has", len(interfaces), "interfaces")
    for i in interfaces:
        if "description" in i:
            print("  " + i["name"] + ": " + i["description"])
print("Inventory complete:", total, "interfaces on", len(SWITCHES), "switches")
